videos.headline: Davis puts Michigan State ahead

videos.headline: Scott extends lead for Spartans
videos.description: LJ Scott bounces it outside and takes it in for the 18-yard touchdown.

videos.headline: Scott lights up Indiana lineman with block
videos.description: LJ Scott doesn't just run the ball, he can block to. Scott delivers a huge block on Indiana defensive lineman Jerome Johnson.

videos.headline: Indiana turns fumble into FG
videos.description: Indiana forces a fumble from Madre London and turns it into a field goal three plays later.

videos.headline: Davis takes double reverse for big gain
videos.description: Felton Davis III swings around the backfield on the double reverse and escapes defenders for the first down.

videos.headline: Dantonio discusses Spartans first half
